description: This file defines the TasksViewEdit class, which extends ViewEdit and is responsible for rendering and handling the edit view of 'Tasks' in SuiteCRM. It includes pre-display logic to set task status based on request parameters and display logic to set default status when duplicating records.

classes.name: TasksViewEdit
classes.description: A class that manages the edit view for Tasks, extending the core ViewEdit class and customizing behavior for task status handling.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Prepares the view by processing request parameters to set the status of the task bean accordingly before rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic, setting the default status if duplicating the task before rendering the view.
